+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib,json,subprocess
+BASE=Path('/mnt/disks/scratch/task-scratch/slskr-pr209-w1623-1642-20261105')
+REPO=BASE/'worktree'; OUT=BASE/'application'; PLAN=json.loads((OUT/'application-plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+def sha(v): return hashlib.sha256(v if isinstance(v,bytes) else v.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
+def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(REPO),*args],text=True).strip()
+head=PLAN['sourcePin']['head']; tree=PLAN['sourcePin']['tree']
+if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=head or git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')!=tree: raise SystemExit('FAIL exact source head/tree')
+if git('status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'): raise SystemExit('FAIL source worktree not clean')
+for path,pin in PLAN['catalogFiles'].items():
+ raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(REPO),'show',f'{head}:{path}'])
+ if sha(raw)!=pin['catalogFileSha256'] or git('rev-parse',f'{head}:{path}')!=pin['catalogGitBlob']: raise SystemExit(f'FAIL exact catalog pin {path}')
+ catalogs={}; raw_before={}
+for path in PLAN['catalogFiles']:
+ raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(REPO),'show',f'{head}:{path}'])
+ obj=json.loads(raw)
+ if list(obj).__len__()!=PLAN['catalogFiles'][path]['keyCount'] or sha('\n'.join(obj.keys()))!=PLAN['catalogFiles'][path]['keyOrderSha256']: raise SystemExit(f'FAIL key order {path}')
+ catalogs[path]=obj; raw_before[path]=raw
+for c in PLAN['changes']:
+ obj=catalogs[c['catalogPath']]; key=c['sourceKey']
+ if key not in obj or sha(key)!=c['sourceKeySha256']: raise SystemExit('FAIL source key')
+ if obj[key]!=c['expectedCurrentTarget'] or sha(obj[key])!=c['expectedCurrentTargetSha256']: raise SystemExit(f'FAIL exact current target {c["position"]}/{c["locale"]}')
+ if sha(c['finalTarget'])!=c['finalTargetSha256']: raise SystemExit('FAIL final target hash')
+ obj[key]=c['finalTarget']

+source=PLAN["sourcePin"]["head"]; product=RECORD["productCommit"]

+if git(repo,"rev-parse",f"{source}^{{tree}}").strip()!=PLAN["sourcePin"]["tree"] or git(repo,"rev-parse",f"{product}^{{tree}}").strip()!=RECORD["productTree"]: raise SystemExit("FAIL commit tree pin")
+changes={(r["position"],r["locale"]):r for r in PLAN["changes"]}
+final=rows(ROOT/"final-readback.jsonl"); cross=rows(BASE/"cross-review/cross-review-ledger.jsonl")

+ before_raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(repo),"show",f"{source}:{path}"])
+ after_raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(repo),"show",f"{product}:{path}"])
+ before=json.loads(before_raw); after=json.loads(after_raw)
+ if sha(before_raw)!=pin["catalogFileSha256"]: raise SystemExit(f"FAIL source file hash {path}")

+ expected=dict(before)

This draft replaces [PR #204](https://github.com/snapetech-org/slskr/pull/204) so the already-pushed localization changes are attached to a pull-request head that matches its branch. The new branch points at that existing commit. No history was rewritten and no commit was amended or copied. The old PR is closed after this replacement is verified; its complete historical review narrative remains available there.

## Localization scope

The audit covers all 12 direct target locales: Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, German, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Arabic, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, and Indonesian. English remains the fallback. Every locale catalog retains the same ordered set of 5,441 keys.

The preceding audit windows, reviews, and readbacks are preserved in the history and evidence linked from PR #204. This replacement carries all existing product and evidence commits plus the current W1523–W1542 follow-up.

## W1523–W1542 review and application

The primary, independent blind, and cross-review packets cover 240 cells across 20 source positions and 12 locales. Cross-review selected 8 target updates, retained 222 current values, and placed 10 cells on hash-only hold where caller context does not resolve whether “backfill” means retroactive loading, completion, or synchronizing missed messages. The approved changes affect the German, French, Hindi, Korean, and Vietnamese catalogs. Readback preserves every other target and all ordered catalog keys.

- Evidence commit / PR head: c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b

This is machine semantic review. Qualified native-speaker approval and exact-head headed-browser acceptance are not claimed. No tests, builds, scans, CI dispatches, workflow edits, merges, releases, or tags were made. The existing .github/workflows files are unchanged.

## W1543–W1562 localization application (2026-11-04)

Applied 27 cross-reviewed corrections in product commit 9f158221682915a9c6c238c5e182871adbf93efd across 11 locale catalogs. Exact readback covered all 240 cells: 208 accepted values and five held values were retained unchanged. All 12 catalogs retain 5,441 keys and their original key order.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build the independent blind review from candidate-free input only."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import hashlib, json, re
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+TASK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+INPUT = TASK / 'candidate-free-input'
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HEAD = '7e366cbf21ad5490bd11ef418a0f2a98b3fbd567'
+TREE = '801d7a037c15dcd83b3e038160054a46c9b8f03b'
+LOCALES = ['es','zh-Hans','hi','de','ja','fr','pt-BR','ar','ko','zh-Hant','vi','id']
+PROPOSALS = {
+    (1628, 'ko'): ('검색 정보를 새로 고치지 못했습니다: {error}', 'The current phrase redundantly combines “search” and “discovery”; this matches the neighboring discovery error while preserving the error placeholder.'),
+    (1631, 'zh-Hant'): ('無法註冊訊息：{error}', '「登錄」means sign in/log in here; 「註冊」correctly expresses registering the message.'),
+    (1633, 'vi'): ('Không thể đăng ký Pod:', 'The current wording translates the technical Pod as “group,” which changes the entity being registered.'),
+    (1638, 'pt-BR'): ('Não foi possível escanear novamente os compartilhamentos', '“Verificar” means check/verify rather than scan; this wording preserves the rescan operation.'),
+    (1641, 'de'): ('Fehler beim Abruf der Informationen für', 'The caller appends the username after this text; moving the failure phrase before “für” makes the combined message grammatical.'),
+    (1641, 'zh-Hans'): ('获取信息失败，用户', 'The caller appends the username after this text; labeling the following name avoids the current phrase’s broken word order.'),
+    (1641, 'hi'): ('जानकारी प्राप्त नहीं हो सकी, उपयोगकर्ता', 'The caller appends the username after this text; this puts the failure clause before a label for that name.'),
+    (1641, 'ja'): ('情報の取得に失敗しました。対象ユーザー', 'The caller appends the username after this text; the current genitive-first fragment cannot attach naturally to the following name.'),
+    (1641, 'ar'): ('تعذر استرداد المعلومات الخاصة بالمستخدم', 'The caller appends the username after this text; this expresses information for the user without leaving the preposition detached.'),
+    (1641, 'ko'): ('사용자 정보를 가져오지 못했습니다. 사용자', 'The caller appends the username after this text; the current sentence ends before that name and leaves “다음에 대한” unresolved.'),
+    (1641, 'zh-Hant'): ('無法取得資訊，使用者', 'The caller appends the username after this text; labeling the following name fixes the current phrase’s word order.'),
+}
+
+def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+def sha_text(text: str) -> str:
+    return sha(text.encode('utf-8'))
+
+def canon(obj) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
+
+def readjl(path: Path):
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+# Ensure review starts only from a sealed candidate-free input and the expected pin.
+manifest = json.loads((INPUT/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+assert manifest['head'] == HEAD and manifest['tree'] == TREE
+assert manifest['candidateFreeInputOnly'] is True and manifest['proposedTranslationsIncluded'] is False
+sums = {}
+for line in (INPUT/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
+    if line.strip():
+        digest, name = line.split(None, 1)
+        sums[name.lstrip('* ')] = digest
+actual = {p.name: sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in INPUT.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name != 'SHA256SUMS.txt'}
+assert sums == actual
+cells = readjl(INPUT/'current-target-cells.jsonl')
+contexts = {r['position']: r for r in readjl(INPUT/'source-contexts.jsonl')}
+assert len(cells) == 240 and len(contexts) == 20
+assert [(r['position'], r['locale']) for r in cells] == [(p,l) for p in range(1623,1643) for l in LOCALES]
+
+rows=[]
+for c in cells:
+    key=(c['position'],c['locale'])
+    ctx=contexts[c['position']]
+    assert c['sourceKey']==ctx['sourceKey'] and c['sourceContextSha256']==ctx['callerContextSha256']
+    assert c['callerCount']==ctx['productionCallerCount'] and ctx['productionCallerCount'] > 0
+    assert sha_text(c['currentTarget'])==c['currentTargetSha256']
+    proposal=PROPOSALS.get(key)
+    if proposal:
+        decision='correction'; target, reason=proposal
+        target_hash=sha_text(target)
+    else:
+        decision='accept'; target=None; target_hash=None
+        if '{error}' in c['sourceKey']:
+            reason='The wording conveys the failed operation naturally, and the {error} placeholder is retained in the caller’s error-message position.'
+        elif c['sourceKey']=='Failed to retrieve information for':
+            reason='The phrase can be followed by the username supplied by this caller and forms a natural user-specific message.'
+        else:
+            reason='The wording accurately conveys the failed action in this application error context and reads naturally for the locale.'
+    row={
+        'position':c['position'], 'locale':c['locale'],
+        'sourceKey':c['sourceKey'], 'sourceKeySha256':c['sourceKeySha256'],
+        'sourceContextSha256':c['sourceContextSha256'],
+        'callerCount':c['callerCount'], 'callerOccurrenceCount':ctx['callerOccurrenceCount'],
+        'catalogPath':c['catalogPath'], 'catalogFileSha256':c['catalogFileSha256'], 'catalogGitBlob':c['catalogGitBlob'],
+        'currentTarget':c['currentTarget'], 'currentTargetSha256':c['currentTargetSha256'],
+        'decision':decision, 'reason':reason,
+        'suggestedTarget':target, 'suggestedTargetSha256':target_hash,
+        'reviewConfidence':'moderate',
+    }
+    row['reviewRecordSha256']=sha(canon(row))
+    rows.append(row)
+
+# Separate proposal and hash-only hold ledgers are linked by cell identity.
+proposals=[]
+for r in rows:
+    if r['decision']=='correction':
+        p={k:r[k] for k in ('position','locale','sourceKeySha256','sourceContextSha256','currentTargetSha256','decision','reason','suggestedTarget','suggestedTargetSha256','reviewConfidence')}
+        p['proposalRecordSha256']=sha(canon(p)); proposals.append(p)
+
+counts=Counter(r['decision'] for r in rows)
+assert counts==Counter({'accept':229,'correction':11})
+input_hashes={name:actual[name] for name in sorted(actual)}
+input_attestation={
+    'repository':'snapetech-org/slskR','pullRequest':209,
+    'exactHead':HEAD,'exactTree':TREE,
+    'candidateFreeVerifierResult':'PASS','candidateFreeVerifier':'verify_candidate_free_full.py',
+    'candidateFreeChecksumListSha256':sha((INPUT/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_bytes()),
+    'inputFilesSha256':input_hashes,
+    'pinnedSourceWorktree':{'path':str(TASK/'worktree'),'head':HEAD,'tree':TREE,'statusClean':True},
+    'initialPRRefs':json.loads((TASK/'attestation'/'pin-before-review.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')),
+    'primaryReviewFilesOpened':False,
+    'browserReviewPerformed':False,'nativeSpeakerReviewPerformed':False,
+    'repositoryEdits':False,'prEdits':False,'testsBuildsScansCI':False,
+}
+(OUT/'review-cells.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+'\n' for r in rows),encoding='utf-8')
+(OUT/'proposals.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+'\n' for r in proposals),encoding='utf-8')
+(OUT/'holds-hash-only.jsonl').write_text('',encoding='utf-8')
+(OUT/'input-attestation.json').write_text(json.dumps(input_attestation,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
+summary={
+    'repository':'snapetech-org/slskR','pullRequest':209,'exactHead':HEAD,'exactTree':TREE,
+    'window':'W1623-W1642','cellCount':len(rows),'sourceCount':20,'localeCount':12,
+    'decisionCounts':dict(sorted(counts.items())),'proposalCount':len(proposals),'hashOnlyHoldCount':0,
+    'callerlessPositions':[],'callerReferences':20,'callerOccurrences':20,'callerFiles':12,
+    'nativeSpeakerReview':False,'browserReview':False,'primaryReviewFilesOpened':False,
+    'repoEdits':False,'prEdits':False,'testsBuildsScansCi':False,
+    'candidateFreeChecksumListSha256':input_attestation['candidateFreeChecksumListSha256'],
+}
+(OUT/'review-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
+manifest_out={
+    'artifact':'slskR PR #209 W1623-W1642 independent blind review',
+    'exactHead':HEAD,'exactTree':TREE,
+    'candidateFreeInputChecksumListSha256':input_attestation['candidateFreeChecksumListSha256'],
+    'cells':240,'sourceKeys':20,'locales':LOCALES,
+    'decisionCounts':dict(sorted(counts.items())), 'proposalCount':len(proposals), 'hashOnlyHoldCount':0,
+    'primaryReviewFilesOpened':False,'semanticReviewIndependent':True,
+    'nativeSpeakerSignoff':False,'browserReview':False,

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Portable offline verifier for the W1623-W1642 blind review packet."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import collections, hashlib, json, re, subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+TASK=OUT.parent
+INPUT=TASK/'candidate-free-input'
+HEAD='7e366cbf21ad5490bd11ef418a0f2a98b3fbd567'
+TREE='801d7a037c15dcd83b3e038160054a46c9b8f03b'
+LOCALES=['es','zh-Hans','hi','de','ja','fr','pt-BR','ar','ko','zh-Hant','vi','id']
+PH=re.compile(r'\{[^{}]+\}')
+MARKUP=re.compile(r'<[^>]+>')
+NUM=re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?(?![A-Za-z0-9])')
+
+def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+def sha_text(s): return sha(s.encode('utf-8'))
+def canon(o): return json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')
+def readj(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+def readjl(p): return [json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if x.strip()]
+def require(ok,msg):
+    if not ok: raise SystemExit('FAIL: '+msg)
+
+def verify_sums(directory):
+    sums_path=directory/'SHA256SUMS.txt'
+    listed={}
+    for line in sums_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
+        if not line.strip(): continue
+        h,n=line.split(None,1); n=n.lstrip('* ')
+        require(n not in listed,'duplicate checksum path '+n)
+        listed[n]=h
+    actual={p.relative_to(directory).as_posix():sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt'}
+    require(listed==actual,'checksum set/content '+str(directory))
+    return listed
+
+input_files=verify_sums(INPUT)
+output_files=verify_sums(OUT)
+manifest=readj(INPUT/'manifest.json')
+require(manifest['head']==HEAD and manifest['tree']==TREE,'candidate-free exact pin')
+require(manifest['selectedPositions']==[1623,1642] and manifest['cellCount']==240,'candidate-free dimensions')
+require(manifest['candidateFreeInputOnly'] is True and manifest['proposedTranslationsIncluded'] is False,'candidate-free scope')
+att=readj(OUT/'input-attestation.json')
+require(att['candidateFreeVerifierResult']=='PASS' and att['primaryReviewFilesOpened'] is False,'blind exposure / input verifier record')
+require(att['candidateFreeChecksumListSha256']==sha((INPUT/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_bytes()),'candidate-free checksum-list pin')
+require(att['inputFilesSha256']==input_files,'input file hashes')
+require(att['initialPRRefs']['headSha']==HEAD and att['initialPRRefs']['headTree']==TREE,'initial PR pin')
+require(att['finalPRRefs']['headSha']==HEAD and att['finalPRRefs']['headTree']==TREE,'final PR pin')
+require(att['initialPRRefs']['branchRefSha']==HEAD and att['initialPRRefs']['pullRefSha']==HEAD,'initial branch/pull refs')
+require(att['finalPRRefs']['branchRefSha']==HEAD and att['finalPRRefs']['pullRefSha']==HEAD,'final branch/pull refs')
+for ref in ('initial','final'):
+    pin=att[f'{ref}PRRefs']
+    stem='pr-api-before-review.json' if ref=='initial' else 'pr-api-final.json'
+    refsfile='remote-refs-before-review.txt' if ref=='initial' else 'remote-refs-final.txt'
+    pinbase=OUT/'attestation'
+    require(pin['prApiSha256']==sha((pinbase/stem).read_bytes()),ref+' PR API seal')
+    require(pin['remoteRefsSha256']==sha((pinbase/refsfile).read_bytes()),ref+' remote refs seal')
+    api=readj(pinbase/stem)
+    require(api['state']=='open' and api['head']['sha']==HEAD and api['head']['ref']=='codex/slskr-l10n-audit-20261104-resync',ref+' PR API identity')
+    require(pin['prBodySha256']==sha((api.get('body') or '').encode()),ref+' body hash')
+commit=readj(OUT/'attestation'/'head-commit-final.json')
+require(commit['sha']==HEAD and commit['tree']==TREE,'final API commit tree')
+repo=Path(att['pinnedSourceWorktree']['path'])
+require(att['pinnedSourceWorktree']['head']==HEAD and att['pinnedSourceWorktree']['tree']==TREE and att['pinnedSourceWorktree']['statusClean'] is True,'worktree attestation')
+require(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==HEAD,'worktree head')
+require(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()==TREE,'worktree tree')
+require(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'status','--porcelain=v1'],text=True).strip()=='','worktree clean')
+
+cells=readjl(INPUT/'current-target-cells.jsonl')
+contexts={r['position']:r for r in readjl(INPUT/'source-contexts.jsonl')}
+rows=readjl(OUT/'review-cells.jsonl')
+proposals=readjl(OUT/'proposals.jsonl')
+holds=readjl(OUT/'holds-hash-only.jsonl')
+require(len(cells)==len(rows)==240,'240 review cell count')
+require([(r['position'],r['locale']) for r in cells]==[(p,l) for p in range(1623,1643) for l in LOCALES],'candidate-free row order')
+require([(r['position'],r['locale']) for r in rows]==[(r['position'],r['locale']) for r in cells],'exact review cell coverage/order')
+source={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in cells}
+require(len(source)==240,'unique candidate-free identities')
+counts=collections.Counter()
+proposal_ids=[]
+for row in rows:
+    key=(row['position'],row['locale']); src=source[key]; ctx=contexts[row['position']]
+    require(row['sourceKey']==src['sourceKey']==ctx['sourceKey'],'source key '+str(key))
+    require(row['sourceKeySha256']==src['sourceKeySha256']==sha_text(src['sourceKey']),'source key hash '+str(key))
+    require(row['sourceContextSha256']==src['sourceContextSha256']==ctx['callerContextSha256'],'caller context hash '+str(key))
+    require(row['callerCount']==src['callerCount']==ctx['productionCallerCount'],'caller count '+str(key))
+    require(row['callerOccurrenceCount']==ctx['callerOccurrenceCount'],'caller occurrence count '+str(key))
+    require(row['catalogPath']==src['catalogPath'] and row['catalogFileSha256']==src['catalogFileSha256'] and row['catalogGitBlob']==src['catalogGitBlob'],'catalog pin '+str(key))
+    require(row['currentTarget']==src['currentTarget'] and row['currentTargetSha256']==src['currentTargetSha256'],'current target binding '+str(key))
+    require(sha_text(row['currentTarget'])==row['currentTargetSha256'],'current target hash '+str(key))
+    require(row['decision'] in {'accept','hold','correction','refinement'},'decision '+str(key))
+    require(isinstance(row.get('reason'),str) and row['reason'].strip(),'review reason '+str(key))
+    rec=row.get('reviewRecordSha256'); body={k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='reviewRecordSha256'}
+    require(rec==sha(canon(body)),'review record hash '+str(key))
+    counts[row['decision']]+=1
+    if row['decision'] in {'correction','refinement'}:
+        target=row.get('suggestedTarget')
+        require(isinstance(target,str) and target.strip(),'proposal wording '+str(key))
+        require(row['suggestedTargetSha256']==sha_text(target),'proposal text hash '+str(key))
+        require(PH.findall(src['sourceKey'])==PH.findall(target),'proposal placeholder parity '+str(key))
+        require(MARKUP.findall(src['sourceKey'])==MARKUP.findall(target),'proposal markup parity '+str(key))
+        require(NUM.findall(src['sourceKey'])==NUM.findall(target),'proposal numeric parity '+str(key))
+        require(all(t in target for t in src['sourceProtectedLiterals']),'proposal protected literals '+str(key))
+        proposal_ids.append(key)
+    else:
+        require(row.get('suggestedTarget') is None and row.get('suggestedTargetSha256') is None,'unexpected proposal '+str(key))
+require(counts==collections.Counter({'accept':229,'correction':11}), 'decision dimensions '+str(dict(counts)))
+require(not holds and manifest['callerResolutionHoldCount']==0,'callerless holds absent only because input has none')
+require(len(proposals)==len(proposal_ids)==11,'proposal ledger count')
+for p in proposals:
+    key=(p['position'],p['locale'])
+    row=next(r for r in rows if (r['position'],r['locale'])==key)
+    require(row['decision']=='correction' and p['suggestedTarget']==row['suggestedTarget'],'proposal ledger link '+str(key))
+    body={k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='proposalRecordSha256'}
+    require(p['proposalRecordSha256']==sha(canon(body)),'proposal record hash '+str(key))
+summary=readj(OUT/'review-summary.json')
+require(summary['exactHead']==HEAD and summary['exactTree']==TREE and summary['cellCount']==240,'review summary pin/count')
+require(summary['decisionCounts']==dict(sorted(counts.items())) and summary['proposalCount']==len(proposals),'review summary decisions')
+require(summary['hashOnlyHoldCount']==0 and summary['callerlessPositions']==[],'review summary hold boundary')
+review_manifest=readj(OUT/'review-manifest.json')
+require(review_manifest['exactHead']==HEAD and review_manifest['exactTree']==TREE and review_manifest['semanticReviewIndependent'] is True,'review manifest pin/scope')
+print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','head':HEAD,'tree':TREE,'cells':len(rows),'decisionCounts':dict(sorted(counts.items())),'proposalCount':len(proposals),'callerlessHoldCount':len(holds),'inputFilesVerified':len(input_files),'outputFilesVerified':len(output_files),'primaryReviewFilesOpened':False,'nativeSpeakerSignoff':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+BASE='1bbaec9fdc63a86de343e37e33bae70d44301a36'; START,END=1623,1642
+LOCS=['es','zh-Hans','hi','de','ja','fr','pt-BR','ar','ko','zh-Hant','vi','id']

+canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
+def j(name): return json.loads((R/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+def jl(name): return [json.loads(s) for s in (R/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if s]
+def jl_from_path(path): return [json.loads(s) for s in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if s]
+def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip()
+def check_sums(path):
+    sums={}
+    for line in (path/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
+        digest,name=line.split(None,1); name=name.lstrip('* '); assert name not in sums; sums[name]=digest
+    actual={p.name for p in path.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt'}
+    assert set(sums)==actual, (path, set(sums)^actual)
+    for name,digest in sums.items(): assert sha((path/name).read_bytes())==digest, (path,name)
+    return sums
+
+m=j('manifest.json')
+assert (m['head'],m['tree'],m['selectedPositions'],m['candidateFreeInputOnly'],m['proposedTranslationsIncluded'])==(HEAD,TREE,[START,END],True,False)

+assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==HEAD and git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==TREE and git('status','--porcelain')==''
+prev_manifest=json.loads((PREV/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); prev_sums=check_sums(PREV)
+assert (prev_manifest['head'],prev_manifest['tree'],prev_manifest['selectedPositions'],prev_manifest['candidateFreeInputOnly'],prev_manifest['proposedTranslationsIncluded'])==('eeb63f1e4e21d801f4a4e0393813b6e86a1ff7c8','590ee410666905f68f601393b64a4798b0609181',[1603,1622],True,False)
+assert set(prev_manifest['fileHashes'])==set(prev_sums)-{'manifest.json'}
+for name,pin in prev_manifest['fileHashes'].items(): assert sha((PREV/name).read_bytes())==pin['sha256'] and (PREV/name).stat().st_size==pin['byteCount']

## Localization scope

The audit covers all 12 direct target locales: Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, German, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Arabic, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, and Indonesian. English remains the fallback. Every locale catalog retains the same ordered set of 5,441 keys.

On 2026-11-04, the PR API and refs/pull/204/head remained at f6fbf614e7e2ff869e4ca86ae96103cff604b79c while the same-repository branch contained two additional, ordinary commits through c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b. ## Localization scope

The audit covers all 12 direct target locales: Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, German, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Arabic, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, and Indonesian. English remains the fallback. Every locale catalog retains the same ordered set of 5,441 keys.

The preceding audit windows, reviews, and readbacks are preserved in the history and evidence linked from PR #204. This replacement carries all existing product and evidence commits plus the current W1523–W1542 follow-up.

## W1523–W1542 review and application

The primary, independent blind, and cross-review packets cover 240 cells across 20 source positions and 12 locales. Cross-review selected 8 target updates, retained 222 current values, and placed 10 cells on hash-only hold where caller context does not resolve whether “backfill” means retroactive loading, completion, or synchronizing missed messages. The approved changes affect the German, French, Hindi, Korean, and Vietnamese catalogs. Readback preserves every other target and all ordered catalog keys.

- Evidence commit / PR head: c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b

This is machine semantic review. Qualified native-speaker approval and exact-head headed-browser acceptance are not claimed. No tests, builds, scans, CI dispatches, workflow edits, merges, releases, or tags were made. The existing .github/workflows files are unchanged.

Applied 27 cross-reviewed corrections in product commit 9f158221682915a9c6c238c5e182871adbf93efd across 11 locale catalogs. Exact readback covered all 240 cells: 208 accepted values and five held values were retained unchanged. All 12 catalogs retain 5,441 keys and their original key order.

Application evidence: docs/pr-evidence/pr209-localization-2026-11-04/window-1543-1562/application/

Reviewed all 240 catalog cells for 20 source messages across 12 locales, including their production callers. +def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+def st(s): return sha(s.encode('utf-8'))
+def canon(x): return json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')
+def readj(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+def readjl(p): return [json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if x.strip()]
+def verify_sums(folder):
+    listed={}
+    for line in (folder/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
+        if line.strip():
+            h,n=line.split(None,1); n=n.lstrip('* '); assert n not in listed; listed[n]=h
+    actual={p.relative_to(folder).as_posix():sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt'}
+    assert listed==actual, f'checksum mismatch or file-set mismatch: {folder}'
+    return listed
+
+cf_sums=verify_sums(CF); p_sums=verify_sums(PRIMARY); b_sums=verify_sums(BLIND)
+cf_manifest=readj(CF/'manifest.json'); pm=readj(PRIMARY/'manifest.json'); bm=readj(BLIND/'review-manifest.json')
+assert cf_manifest['head']==pm['exactHead']==bm['exactHead']==HEAD
+assert cf_manifest['tree']==pm['exactTree']==bm['exactTree']==TREE
+assert cf_manifest['cellCount']==240 and cf_manifest['candidateFreeInputOnly'] is True
+assert pm['candidateFreeChecksumListSha256']==sha((CF/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_bytes())

+cells=readjl(CF/'current-target-cells.jsonl')
+contexts={r['position']:r for r in readjl(CF/'source-contexts.jsonl')}
+p_rows=readjl(PRIMARY/'primary-ledger.jsonl'); b_rows=readjl(BLIND/'review-cells.jsonl')
+pmap={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in p_rows}; bmap={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in b_rows}
+cmap={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in cells}
+p_props={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in readjl(PRIMARY/'proposals.jsonl')}
+b_props={(r['position'],r['locale']):r for r in readjl(BLIND/'proposals.jsonl')}
+assert len(cells)==len(p_rows)==len(b_rows)==240 and len(cmap)==len(pmap)==len(bmap)==240
+assert len(contexts)==20 and len(p_props)==9 and len(b_props)==11
+assert set(ROOT_RECOMMENDATIONS)==set(p_props)|set(b_props)
+
+cross=[]; adjudications=[]
+for c in cells:

+    assert p['sourceKey']==b['sourceKey']==c['sourceKey']==ctx['sourceKey']
+    assert p['sourceKeySha256']==b['sourceKeySha256']==c['sourceKeySha256']==st(c['sourceKey'])
+    assert p['sourceContextSha256']==b['sourceContextSha256']==c['sourceContextSha256']==ctx['callerContextSha256']
+    assert p['currentTarget']==b['currentTarget']==c['currentTarget']
+    assert p['currentTargetSha256']==b['currentTargetSha256']==c['currentTargetSha256']==st(c['currentTarget'])
+    assert p['callerCount']==b['callerCount']==c['callerCount']==ctx['productionCallerCount']
+    assert p['callerOccurrenceCount']==b['callerOccurrenceCount']==ctx['callerOccurrenceCount']
+    assert p['catalogPath']==b['catalogPath']==c['catalogPath']
+    assert p['catalogFileSha256']==b['catalogFileSha256']==c['catalogFileSha256']
+    assert p['catalogGitBlob']==b['catalogGitBlob']==c['catalogGitBlob']
+    assert p['candidateFreeCellRecordSha256']==sha(canon(c))
+    p_proposed=p['decision'] in {'correction','refinement'}
+    b_proposed=b['decision'] in {'correction','refinement'}
+    assert p_proposed==(k in p_props) and b_proposed==(k in b_props)
+    if p_proposed and b_proposed:
+        reconciliation='both-proposed-same-target' if p['proposedTarget']==b['suggestedTarget'] else 'both-proposed-different-target'
+    elif p_proposed:
+        reconciliation='primary-only-proposal'
+    elif b_proposed:
+        reconciliation='blind-only-proposal'
+    else:
+        reconciliation='both-accept-current'
+    if k in ROOT_RECOMMENDATIONS:
+        target,reason=ROOT_RECOMMENDATIONS[k]; decision='correction'; target_hash=st(target)
+    else:
+        target=None; reason='Rechecked the current text against the source meaning, exact caller context, and locale; the current wording is suitable.'
+        decision='accept-current'; target_hash=None
+    paths=sorted({x['path'] for x in ctx['callers']})
+    record={
+      'position':c['position'],'locale':c['locale'],'sourceKey':c['sourceKey'],'sourceKeySha256':c['sourceKeySha256'],
+      'sourceTextSha256':st(c['sourceKey']),'sourceContextSha256':c['sourceContextSha256'],
+      'callerCount':c['callerCount'],'callerOccurrenceCount':ctx['callerOccurrenceCount'],'callerPaths':paths,
+      'catalogPath':c['catalogPath'],'catalogFileSha256':c['catalogFileSha256'],'catalogGitBlob':c['catalogGitBlob'],
+      'currentTarget':c['currentTarget'],'currentTargetSha256':c['currentTargetSha256'],
+      'candidateFreeCellRecordSha256':sha(canon(c)),
+      'primaryDecision':p['decision'],'primaryProposedTarget':p.get('proposedTarget'),'primaryProposedTargetSha256':p.get('proposedTargetSha256'),
+      'primaryRationale':p['rationale'] if p_proposed else None,
+      'primaryCellRecordSha256':sha(canon(p)),
+      'blindDecision':b['decision'],'blindSuggestedTarget':b['suggestedTarget'],'blindSuggestedTargetSha256':b['suggestedTargetSha256'],
+      'blindReason':b['reason'] if b_proposed else None,'blindReviewRecordSha256':b['reviewRecordSha256'],
+      'proposalReconciliation':reconciliation,'rootDisposition':decision,

+      'rootRationale':reason,'reviewConfidence':'moderate',
+    }
+    record['crossReviewRecordSha256']=sha(canon(record))

+    if p_proposed or b_proposed:
+        adjudication={k2:record[k2] for k2 in ('position','locale','sourceKey','sourceKeySha256','sourceContextSha256','currentTarget','currentTargetSha256','primaryDecision','primaryProposedTarget','primaryProposedTargetSha256','primaryRationale','blindDecision','blindSuggestedTarget','blindSuggestedTargetSha256','blindReason','proposalReconciliation','rootDisposition','rootRecommendedTarget','rootRecommendedTargetSha256','rootRationale','reviewConfidence')}
+        adjudication['adjudicationRecordSha256']=sha(canon(adjudication))
+        adjudications.append(adjudication)
+
+pids=set(p_props); bids=set(b_props); union=pids|bids; overlap=pids&bids
+same_targets={k for k in overlap if p_props[k]['proposedTarget']==b_props[k]['suggestedTarget']}
+counts=collections.Counter(r['rootDisposition'] for r in cross)

This draft replaces [PR #204](https://github.com/snapetech-org/slskr/pull/204) so the already-pushed localization changes are attached to a pull-request head that matches its branch. On 2026-11-04, the PR API and refs/pull/204/head remained at f6fbf614e7e2ff869e4ca86ae96103cff604b79c while the same-repository branch contained two additional, ordinary commits through c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b. The new branch points at that existing commit. No history was rewritten and no commit was amended or copied. The old PR is closed after this replacement is verified; its complete historical review narrative remains available there.

## Localization scope

The audit covers all 12 direct target locales: Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, German, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Arabic, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, and Indonesian. English remains the fallback. Every locale catalog retains the same ordered set of 5,441 keys.

The preceding audit windows, reviews, and readbacks are preserved in the history and evidence linked from PR #204. This replacement carries all existing product and evidence commits plus the current W1523–W1542 follow-up.

## W1523–W1542 review and application

The primary, independent blind, and cross-review packets cover 240 cells across 20 source positions and 12 locales. Cross-review selected 8 target updates, retained 222 current values, and placed 10 cells on hash-only hold where caller context does not resolve whether “backfill” means retroactive loading, completion, or synchronizing missed messages. The approved changes affect the German, French, Hindi, Korean, and Vietnamese catalogs. Readback preserves every other target and all ordered catalog keys.

- Product commit: 09497027d7ca64892cf8ce3530dd5cc1fdf93c15
- Evidence commit / PR head: c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b
- [Complete review, application, and readback evidence](https://github.com/snapetech-org/slskr/tree/c15eddffec2c4c24cc091b2a6ebf0c43fa58ef1b/docs/pr-evidence/pr204-semantic-review-2026-11-04/independent-1523-1542-root-application/)

## Review and validation limits

This is machine semantic review. Qualified native-speaker approval and exact-head headed-browser acceptance are not claimed. No tests, builds, scans, CI dispatches, workflow edits, merges, releases, or tags were made. The existing .github/workflows files are unchanged.

## W1543–W1562 localization application (2026-11-04)
